description: Entwurf für eine einheitliche und reproduzierbare Zertifizierung der sechs bestehenden Backtest-Arten. Vorgeschlagene Schwellen gelten erst nach ausdrücklicher fachlicher Freigabe.
scope: Shared certification methodology for the six existing backtest kinds. This document does not change engine behavior, existing gates, artifacts, or statuses.

HISTORICAL_INDEX_MEMBERSHIP.useWhen: The claim is about an index or index strategy.

ALL_THEN_TRADEABLE_LISTINGS.useWhen: The claim is market-wide or generally about eligible equities.

CUSTOM_STRATEGY_UNIVERSE.useWhen: A strategy has a specifically defined membership and rebalance rule.

identity.tickerReuse: Separate listing identity or non-overlapping validity intervals; ambiguous mappings quarantine observations.
identity.delisting: Include listing through last tradable time; require sourced terminal value/return or mark outcome UNKNOWN and censored.
identity.unknownDelistingReturn: Never replace with zero, last price, or -100%; fail survivorship if bounds can change the primary conclusion.
identity.mergerAndSpinOff: Record predecessor/successor graph, exchange ratio, cash/stock terms, event dates, announcement availability, source, and return factor; unresolved outcomes are censored.

modes.AS_PUBLISHED_PIT: Only data vintages with available_at/published_at no later than decision time; preserve immutable source version and hash.
modes.HISTORICAL_SIMULATION: Ex-post reconstruction only; explicitly labeled; cannot claim historical PIT availability, replace published snapshots, or inherit certification.

timeAndData.returnBasis: Canonical total return for equities; splits and distributions included; price return may be reported only as a separate diagnostic.
timeAndData.coverageUnit: expected event/outcome observations, including exclusions and censored outcomes
timeAndData.coverageNote: Proposed V1 threshold, not yet approved. Existing stricter gates remain. Any unresolved identity/corporate-action break affecting primary sample is a hard block.
timeAndData.missingData: Preserve missing/UNKNOWN; no forward fill, interpolation, zero fill, or silent exclusion. Predeclare exclusion policy and report denominators.
timeAndData.benchmark: Same return basis and aligned time axis; use preregistered matched base rate and a question-appropriate passive total-return benchmark.

regimeGate.note: Normative proposed thresholds require owner ratification. Retrospectively classified regimes are simulation-only, not PIT evidence. Insufficient state coverage is reported as INSUFFICIENT, never pooled silently.

validation.purgeEmbargo: At least longest outcome horizon plus cooldown; overlapping outcomes cannot cross train/test boundaries.
validation.oos: Chronological holdout not viewed during rule selection; previously inspected outcomes cannot be relabeled as untouched.
validation.parameterAndEntrySensitivity: Predeclared diagnostics only; never select a winning neighbor after seeing outcomes.
validation.multipleTesting: Count all explored rules/variants; use preregistered error control for simultaneous claims and a fresh holdout for the selected rule.
validation.effectiveSample: Report issuer/listing and time-cluster robust uncertainty, cluster count, effective N, and raw event count separately.

evidenceAndEconomics.primaryEventStudyEndpoint: Preregistered net canonical total-return median excess versus matched contemporaneous comparison cohort.
evidenceAndEconomics.statisticalEffect: Preregistered two-sided 95% cluster-robust interval excludes zero after applicable multiplicity correction; report sign.

backtestKinds.universe: Single-stock replay is conditional/descriptive; any success-rate or strategy claim needs all eligible then-tradeable listings, including failures and delistings.
All then-tradeable listings eligible for the predeclared pattern, or named PIT index membership.
All then-tradeable listings in a predeclared market segment, or PIT index/custom strategy membership; include later delistings.
PIT membership of setup-eligible listings at every setup timestamp, with delisted outcomes retained.
PIT strategy membership and rebalance snapshots; PIT index membership when index-defined.
All eligible listings in the fixed PIT market/index universe at each rebalance; never current survivors.

new52WeekHighReplication.ruleFrozen: Weekly close exceeds every close in the prior 52 weeks and was not true in the preceding week.
new52WeekHighReplication.entry: Close of the week after signal
new52WeekHighReplication.universe: All then-listed primary US common-equity listings on NYSE, Nasdaq, and NYSE American, including later delistings; PIT exclusions for ADRs, funds/ETFs, preferred, warrants, rights, OTC, and non-common instruments; no unregistered price/liquidity filters.
new52WeekHighReplication.returnBasis: Canonical total return for signal and matched base rate; SPY total return as passive benchmark.
new52WeekHighReplication.independentTest: Prospectively sealed PIT cohort after preregistration; same historical dates from a different vendor are not an untouched outcome holdout.

knownPartialSources: Tiingo price/listing/corporate-action fields (coverage and license must be checked)
SEC filed/accepted timestamps for filings, not listing membership
internal recent regime/membership and partial delisted-series artifacts

implementationPlan.work: Ratify normative thresholds, universe defaults, MDE, regime criteria, and legal use rights.
Map each gate to existing producer, test, artifact, and consumer without changing thresholds.
implementationPlan.acceptance: Traceability matrix has evidence source for every gate

implementationPlan.work: Read-only provider field/license PoC on a fixed sample.
implementationPlan.estimate: 5-10 engineering days after access; provider/legal lead time about 1-3 weeks
implementationPlan.acceptance: Identity, PIT, coverage, repeatability, and rights criteria pass or documented no-go

implementationPlan.work: Build limited data manifest/adapter only after PoC approval.
implementationPlan.acceptance: Hashed reproducible PIT manifest; identity and return parity gates pass

implementationPlan.work: Independent data, regime, statistical, and result reproduction audit.
implementationPlan.acceptance: All existing and ratified V1 gates pass; separate certification decision

implementationPlan.work: Prospective NEW_52W_HIGH independent holdout and regime collection.
implementationPlan.estimate: At least 5 years plus 6-month outcome lag unless a provably unseen licensed historical cohort exists
implementationPlan.acceptance: Preregistered power, regime, and holdout minimums reached
